g.title: G6PD
g.text: G6PD DEFICIENCY (포도당-6-인산 탈수소효소 결핍증) — QSP mechanistic map
enzyme activity as a function of CELL AGE · a critical age sweeping the age distribution · one NADPH pool read by two consumers
primaquine · tafenoquine · dapsone · rasburicase · methylene blue · favism · neonatal kernicterus

g.title: cluster_gene
g.text: 1. 유전형 Genotype · WHO variant class (X-linked, Xq28 — the variant sets tau, the enzyme half-life IN the cell)

g.title: cluster_intra

g.title: cluster_epo

g.text: 11. 메트헤모글로빈과 메틸렌블루의 함정 — the second NADPH consumer, and why the antidote is contraindicated

g.title: LG2
g.text: THE ONE LINE THE WHOLE MAP HANGS ON
E(a) = E0 · exp(−ln2 · a / τ) τ is the VARIANT
B 62 d · A− 13 d · Mediterranean 6 d (and E0 0.06)
A steep τ leaves young survivors → haemolysis
A flat, low curve leaves none → haemolysis
Same "<10% activity" label. Two different diseases.
The whole-blood assay reports the age-weighted MEAN of E(a) —
which reticulocytosis raises, so it reads normal at the nadir.
